description:
FILED s473t5c (#1501 round 4, `comp/` CHECK 2).  PRE-EXISTING.  The single
largest row count in `comp/`: t/comp/utf.t is DIFF 24/4192 of 4216 rows, and
all 4192 are this.

perl detects a script's SOURCE encoding from its leading bytes: a UTF-8 BOM, a
UTF-16BE/LE BOM (and UTF-32, and the BOM-less UTF-16 heuristics) are decoded
before the lexer sees them, and an encoding perl cannot handle dies
"Unsupported script encoding <ENC>" -- which is what utf.t's own skip branch
looks for.  The file writes 4216 little scripts with `pack` in UTF-8,
UTF-16BE and UTF-16LE, with and without a BOM, with and without a trailing
newline, and `do`es each one.

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):

    sub wf { my ($n,$b)=@_; open my $f,'>',$n or die; binmode $f; print $f $b; close $f }
    wf("u8.pl",  pack("C*", 0xEF,0xBB,0xBF) . "123\n");
    wf("u16.pl", pack("v*", 0xFEFF, map { ord } split //, "123\n"));
    wf("plain.pl", "123\n");
    print "U8BOM  got=[", (do "./u8.pl"   // 'undef'), "] err=[$@]\n";
    print "U16LE  got=[", (do "./u16.pl"  // 'undef'), "] err=[$@]\n";
    print "PLAIN  got=[", (do "./plain.pl"// 'undef'), "] err=[$@]\n";

    perl:  U8BOM got=[123]      U16LE got=[123]     PLAIN got=[123]
    PCL :  U8BOM got=[123]      U16LE got=[undef]   PLAIN got=[123]
                                err=[PCL: cannot parse (inline code):
                                     PPI failed to tokenize it at (eval 2) line 1.]

So the UTF-8 BOM is already handled and the UTF-16 half is not: the raw
little-endian bytes reach PPI, which fails to tokenize, and the refusal is
perl-shaped and trappable (good) but the row is a fail (correctly -- perl
neither dies nor skips here).

THE BLESSED ATTRIBUTION IS STALE, which is why this task exists.
`baselines/perl-suite-run.tsv`'s `sig` for comp/utf.t reads
`s470bv: #1115 (already 24/4192 at a3d6d8e, 12/4204 at 614c6af)`, but **#1115
is COMPLETED** and its subject is a different fact -- "PCL's open() decodes
UTF-8 by default where perl reads BYTES".  #1115 was the right pointer while
the bytes of a `do FILE` were being mis-measured; the residue after it closed
is a missing SOURCE-encoding decode, which is this task.  Rows attributed to
#1693 from s473t5c on.

FIX SHAPE: the decode belongs where the source TEXT is produced, before
`_ppi_parse` -- one reading for the file entry (`pl2cl`), `do FILE` and
`require` alike, keyed on the leading bytes (perl's own table: EF BB BF =
UTF-8; FE FF / FF FE = UTF-16BE/LE; 00 00 FE FF / FF FE 00 00 = UTF-32) and
DYING "Unsupported script encoding <ENC>" for what it cannot do, because that
is the string utf.t's skip branch matches and a rule-12 die is right here (the
value the program then consumes is the whole program).  NOTE the interaction
with `use utf8` (guard `Pl/t/utf8-source-01.t`): that pragma decodes UTF-8
source text and is orthogonal -- a BOM decode happens FIRST and unconditionally.

The file's 24 passing rows are the UTF-8 cases; 4192 is every UTF-16 case.
subject: A UTF-16/UTF-32 BOM-prefixed SOURCE file is not decoded before parsing, so `do "utf16.pl"` fails PPI's tokenizer -- t/comp/utf.t's 4,192 rows, and the file's blessed #1115 attribution is STALE (#1115 is completed and is about open())
